args.sql:
WITH high_risk_cases AS (
    SELECT 
        e.facid,
        COUNT(*) AS high_risk_count,
        COUNT(*) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT e.enckey) OVER (PARTITION BY e.facid) AS high_risk_prevalence
    FROM 
        encounters e
    JOIN 
        assessmentsymptomsandrisk a ON e.abref = a.asrkey
    WHERE 
        a.mental_health_scores->'High-Risk Patient' ILIKE '%high risk%'
    GROUP BY 
        e.facid
),
facility_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        f.fackey AS facility_id,
        f.support_and_resources->>'PFIS' AS PFIS,
        f.support_and_resources->>'FRAI' AS FRAI,
        (f.support_and_resources->>'PFIS')::NUMERIC - (f.support_and_resources->>'FRAI')::NUMERIC AS RDD
    FROM 
        facilities f
    JOIN 
        high_risk_cases hrc ON f.fackey = hrc.facid
    WHERE 
        hrc.high_risk_prevalence > 20
)
SELECT 
    fs.facility_id, fs.PFIS, fs.FRAI, fs.RDD
FROM 
    facility_scores fs
ORDER BY 
    fs.RDD DESC;
